resources.string: Copy this day\'s plan to another day
Copy this day\'s plan to multiple days
Add last week\'s plan to this week

Original plans are added as Planned. Existing plans stay; identical Planned items are skipped. Only fasts starting on the source day (or in the previous week) are copied. Each stays one full event, with its local start time and elapsed duration. A clock-change time that does not exist cancels the copy.
Add the plan from %1$s – %2$s to %3$s – %4$s on corresponding weekdays? Existing plans will not be deleted.
